name: Shagaru Magala
about: Monster id 164 on the server. The field guide's tables (the Ferias project) have no entry for it, so there are no HP, hitzone, stagger or carve tables here yet. It appears in 12 quests, all in Shagaru Magala's arena (map 94): Exotic and G★8 Exotic quests, the Shagaru GX upgrade quest and migration quests.
